211/**
212 *  <p>{@summary The base class for all SVG elements.}</p>
213 *  <p>Some internal elements are even implemented by this class only (that's
214 *  why it is not abstract).</p>
215 *
216 *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
217 *  @version $Id: SVGElementImpl.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $
218 *  @since 0.0.5
219 */
220@SuppressWarnings( {"ClassWithTooManyMethods", "OverlyComplexClass"} )
221@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: SVGElementImpl.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $" )
222@API( status = INTERNAL, since = "0.0.5" )
223public sealed class SVGElementImpl extends XMLElementAdapter implements SVGElement
224    permits SVGElementAdapter, SVGClipPathImpl, SVGGroupImpl, SVGImpl, SVGLineImpl, SVGMarkerImpl, SVGPathImpl, SVGRectangleImpl, SVGStyleImpl, SVGSymbolImpl, SVGTextBase, SVGUseImpl
225{
226        /*------------*\
227    ====** Attributes **=======================================================
228        \*------------*/
229    /**
230     *  Flag that indicates whether a description was already provided for this
231     *  element.
232     */
233    private boolean m_HasDescription;
234
235    /**
236     *  Flag that indicates whether a title was already provided for this
237     *  element.
238     */
239    private boolean m_HasTitle;
240
241        /*--------------*\
242    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
243        \*--------------*/
244    /**
245     *  Creates a new {@code SVGElementImpl} instance.
246     *
247     *  @param  elementName The name of the element.
248     *  @param  flags   The configuration flags for the new element.
249     */
250    protected SVGElementImpl( final String elementName, final Flags... flags )
251    {
252        super( elementName, Set.of( requireNonNullArgument( flags, "flags" ) ) );
253
254        m_HasDescription = false;
255        m_HasTitle = false;
256    }   //  SVGElementImpl()
257
258        /*---------*\
259    ====** Methods **==========================================================
260        \*---------*/
261    /**
262     *  Adds a child to this element.
263     *
264     *  @param  <E> The implementation type for the {@code children}.
265     *  @param  child   The child to add.
266     *  @throws IllegalArgumentException    The given child is not valid for
267     *      this element or no children are allowed at all.
268     *  @throws IllegalStateException   The child has already a parent that is
269     *      not this element.
270     */
271    public <E extends SVGElement> void addChild( final E child ) throws IllegalArgumentException, IllegalStateException
272    {
273        addChild( (XMLElement) child );
274    }   //  addChild()
275
276    /**
277     *  Sets the abort handler for this SVG element.
278     *
279     *  @param  value   The abort handler.
280     *
281     *  @see org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.svg.SVGUtils#SVGATTRIBUTE_OnAbort
282     */
283    public void setAbortHandler( final String value ) { setAttribute( SVGATTRIBUTE_OnAbort, value, NO_APPEND ); }
284
285    /**
286     *  Sets the activation handler for this SVG element.
287     *
288     *  @param  value   The activation handler.
289     *
290     *  @see org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.svg.SVGUtils#SVGATTRIBUTE_OnActivate
291     */
292    public void setActivationHandler( final String value ) { setAttribute( SVGATTRIBUTE_OnActivate, value, NO_APPEND ); }
293
294    /**
295     *  Sets the presentation attribute {@code alignment-baseline} for this SVG element.
296     *
297     *  @param  value   The attribute type.
298     *
299     *  @see org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.svg.SVGUtils#SVGATTRIBUTE_AlignmentBaseline
300     */
301    public void setAlignmentBaseline( final SVGAlignmentBaseLine value )
302    {
303        setAttribute( SVGATTRIBUTE_AlignmentBaseline, nonNull( value ) ? value.toString() : null, NO_APPEND );
304    }   //  setAlignmentBaseline()
305
306    /**
307     *  Sets the attribute with the given name.
308     *
309     *  @param  name    The name of the attribute; the name is case-sensitive.
310     *  @param  value   The attribute's type; if {@code null} the

515    /**
516     *  Sets the description for the SVG element.<br>
517     *  <br>This is not an attribute, instead a
518     *  <code>&lt;{@value org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.svg.SVGUtils#SVGELEMENT_Description}&gt;</code>
519     *  element will be added as a child.
520     *
521     *  @param  description The description; nothing happens if {@code null},
522     *      empty, or blank.
523     *  @throws IllegalStateException   The given description is not
524     *      {@code null}, empty, or blank, and a title was applied already
525     *      earlier.
526     */
527    public void setDescription( final CharSequence description )
528    {
529        if( isNotEmptyOrBlank( description ) )
530        {
531            if( m_HasDescription ) throw new IllegalStateException( "Description was already set" );
532
533            final var element = new SVGElementImpl( SVGELEMENT_Description, ALLOWS_TEXT );
534            element.updateRegistries( emptyList(), emptyList() );
535            element.addText( description );
536            addChild( (SVGElement) element );
537            m_HasDescription = true;
538        }
539    }   //  setDescription()

1622        {
1623            if( m_HasTitle ) throw new IllegalStateException( "Title was already set" );
1624
1625            final var element = new SVGElementImpl( SVGELEMENT_Title, ALLOWS_TEXT );
1626            element.updateRegistries( emptyList(), emptyList() );
1627            element.addText( title );
1628            addChild( (SVGElement) element );
1629            m_HasTitle = true;
1630        }
1631    }   //  setTitle()

1847    /**
1848     *  Updates the registries with the valid children and attributes for this
1849     *  element.
1850     *
1851     *  @param  childElements   The names of valid child elements.
1852     *  @param  attributes  The names of valid attributes <i>in the sequence
1853     *      they should have when the element written to output</i>.
1854     */
1855    protected final void updateRegistries( final Collection<String> childElements, final Collection<String> attributes )
1856    {
1857        registerValidChildren( requireNonNullArgument( childElements, "childElements" ).toArray( EMPTY_String_ARRAY ) );
1858
1859        registerValidAttributes( requireNonNullArgument( attributes, "attributes" ).toArray( EMPTY_String_ARRAY ) );
1860
1861        if( !attributes.isEmpty() )
1862        {
1863            final var attributeSequence = attributes.stream().distinct().toArray( String []::new );
1864            registerAttributeSequence( attributeSequence );
1865        }
1866    }   //  updateRegistries()
